## Summary

Describe the problem and the change in a few sentences.

## Related issue

Link the issue or explain why this pull request stands alone.

## Verification

List the commands and manual checks you ran, with results.
Explain any check you could not run.

## Review notes

Call out behavior changes, tradeoffs, configuration or migration steps, and known limitations.
For visible UI changes, include before and after screenshots at relevant screen sizes.
Remove credentials, tokens, signed URLs, and customer data from screenshots and logs.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] Tests cover behavior that can regress, where applicable.
- [ ] Generated files were updated through their generators, where applicable.
- [ ] I checked for secrets and sensitive data.
